chunks: Bakr ibn Muhammad al-Azdi narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
My father asked him while I was listening about the extent of illness in which a person leaves the fast. He said: 'When he is not able to take suhoor.'

key_terms.الْمَرَضِ: illness that affects one's ability to fast
key_terms.حَدِّ: the limit or defining extent of a ruling
key_terms.يَتَسَحَّرَ: to take the pre-dawn meal before fasting

ai.seo_question: What level of illness allows a person to leave the fast in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal indicator for the degree of illness that permits leaving the fast. It identifies inability to take suhoor as a sign that the illness has reached a level at which fasting may be left.
